broker_restart: reconnect/reconcile: retained state is restored from persistence and no non-retained event is replayed
dropped_retained: reconcile: Git reconstructs current truth even when the retained ref-change hint is dropped
duplicate_replay: one logical item: a duplicate QoS 1 event is deduped and a re-delivered state revision is not re-applied
invalid_retained: typed validation refusal: a privileged fixture publisher's malformed retained payload is rejected with a typed error
git_fetch_failure: degraded Git result: an unreachable configured remote yields a typed GitFailure with no ref or worktree mutation
revoked_credential: authentication refusal: a revoked credential cannot reconnect while an unrevoked peer keeps access
clock_skew: bounded expiry decision: a lease is honored within the skew tolerance and rejected one second beyond it
